description: Evidence-led space candidate clusters for small bodies, stellar evolution, galaxy structure, compact-object reconstruction, solar weather, orbital operations, planetary surface exploration, and explicitly speculative systems. Broad space vocabulary remains advisory; only narrow exact phrases in the visual-obligation registry create hard pixel duties.

semantic_policy.hard_activation: Only narrow exact phrases in the visual-obligation registry create hard duties. Universe, cosmos, space, galaxy, black hole, star, planet, astronaut, science fiction, dark matter, dark energy, exoplanet, alien, wormhole, warp, Dyson sphere, and terraforming remain candidate-only without a requester definition or explicit profile selection.
semantic_policy.visual_actuation: Observable structures are separated into source or actor, geometry, interaction or process, and consequence. Partial presence is failure for a selected hard contract.
semantic_policy.representation_boundary: visible-light observation, false-color or multiwavelength imagery, measurement reconstruction, scientific simulation or map, and artist concept or fiction must remain explicitly distinguishable in candidate interpretation and render review.
semantic_policy.evidence_boundary: Authoritative astronomy and engineering sources support component meanings and confusion limits; generated pixels do not prove a new scientific observation, mission event, or future system exists.

representation_modes.meaning: Optical or directly visible scene evidence with ordinary photographic appearance.
Instrument bands are mapped into display colors; color is analytical encoding rather than ordinary eye appearance.
Sparse or indirect measurements are reconstructed into an image whose resolution and uncertainty remain visible.
A model, map, or explanatory visualization is labeled as such and does not claim direct observation.
Speculative structures are visibly presented as original design concepts rather than observed fact.

visual_semantics.primary_visual_proposition: Solar heating produces a compact comet head, diffuse coma, and continuous anti-solar activity in an encounter scene.
An embedded young source, flattened dust disk, and perpendicular bipolar outflow make stellar birth physically legible.
Two identifiable galaxies share tidal deformation, a bridge or tails, and one coherent encounter geometry.
A measurement-derived black-hole shadow is enclosed by a thick asymmetric emission ring with reconstruction texture.
A coronagraph mask and solar-center registration reveal a broad outward coronal-mass-ejection front.
A complete EVA system, vehicle restraint, and direct hardware contact make exterior work operationally legible.
A grounded mobile rover engages one surface target and leaves an immediate instrument or sampling result.
An original artist-concept megastructure remains mechanically coherent through orbit, scale, habitation, energy, and assembly evidence without being presented as an observation.
